Grrr!! Noble Kidnappers (Japanese: キリキリ！！ 高貴な誘拐犯 Grind!! The High-Class Kidnappers) is the 22nd chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 

==Major events==
Sonia gets attacked while riding in a Flying Taxi, causing it to crash land.
Sonia is rescued by Leon and taken to Hammerlocke.
Sordward and Shielbert try to bargain with for a camera using her remaining .
